title: I'm bad at Go, so I made a free 9×9 trainer with a coach that explains every move
author: Slackluster
selftext:
GoYomi runs in your browser, no install or account! Play 9×9 against an AI with a coach that grades and explains every move.

At max difficulty it's a strong intermediate opponent: it beat GNU Go 17 of 20 games.

It also shows liberties, atari warnings, territory, and what your opponent is planning. You can take back moves and explore variations.

Play: [https://killedbyapixel.github.io/GoYomi/](https://killedbyapixel.github.io/GoYomi/)

Source (GPL-3.0): [https://github.com/KilledByAPixel/GoYomi](https://github.com/KilledByAPixel/GoYomi)

Happy to get feedback, especially from stronger players on whether the explanations are right.
